result.title: Reasoning Supervision and Capability Retention in LoRA Domain Adaptation
result.summary: Fine-tuning foundation models on financial data has a wide range of applications, including identifying event types from news, monitoring risk and compliance language, and answering questions over filings and earnings calls. In this setting, the main challenge is to improve task performance without degrading the generalization capabilities of the model. In this paper, we present an extensive set of ablations for fine-tuning Qwen3-8B with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We compare three training regimes: (1) response-only LoRA, where the supervised response is the label alone; (2) single-adapter reasoning, where reasoning traces from a teacher model are included alongside the labels in the training loss; and (3) dual-adapter composite training, where separate LoRA adapters are trained on traces and labels. Response-only LoRA improves in-domain performance and leaves general capabilities near those of the frozen model. The in-domain change is largest for calibration and argmax accuracy. Under single-adapter reasoning, the in-domain metrics remain behind those of the response-only regime, while MMLU-Pro can rise slightly and the other retention benchmarks stay within ordinary variation. Dual-adapter composite training remains on the same side of this comparison and yields no further gain. Finally, we compress the teacher traces by summarizing them before training, and show that shorter summaries move calibration toward the response-only regime without reaching it.

AI.brief_summary: 该文在金融领域数据上用 LoRA 微调 Qwen3-8B，比较三种训练方案：仅对答案监督、把教师模型推理轨迹与标签一并纳入损失的单适配器训练、以及分别对轨迹和标签训练两个适配器的复合方案，并额外测试将轨迹压缩为摘要后再训练的效果。结果显示仅答案监督的域内提升最明显且通用能力接近冻结模型，加入推理轨迹并未带来更好域内指标，双适配器也无额外收益。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本实验，不涉及视觉状态，但其关于「轨迹监督是否真正贡献性能、以及它与仅答案监督在指标与校准上的差异」的消融，可供核查 LVR 中轨迹训练、贡献分配与监督信号设计的取舍，仅作方法线索参考。
